subject: Evaluation plan milestone summary + next-week MAP agenda
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Evaluation plan milestone summary + next-week MAP agenda

Hi team — quick recap from today's checkpoint and attachments with the updated MAP (v1.3) attached. TL;DR: core eval pass is green, procurement step pending (PO + SOW), and we need sign-off on the performance SLA before close.

Decisions made today:
- Evaluation criteria: latency P95 target of <120ms and embedding cosine threshold >= 0.87 for search intents (owner: Marcus).
- Security checklist: Acme asked for one additional KMS integration note (owner: Laura).
- Pilot timeline: 2-week pilot starting after procurement sign-off; target start 2026-12-20 (owner: Priyom).

Action items (owners / due dates):
- Marcus: finalize benchmark report and attach token-level cost estimate (due 2026-12-06).
- Laura: draft KMS integration note and send to Acme security for confirmation (due 2026-12-07).
- Marissa: prepare updated SLA doc reflecting the P95 commitment and fallback policy (due 2026-12-09).
- Acme (Jordan / procurement): provide PO approval or redlines (requested by 2026-12-10).

Next-week MAP checkpoint (agenda):
1) Review Marcus's benchmark numbers and cost sensitivity.
2) Confirm KMS note alignment and any additional compliance asks.
3) Review Marissa's SLA draft and confirm acceptance criteria for go/no-go.
4) Procurement status and expected PO timeline.

Attachments: MAP-v1.3.xlsx (worksheet: milestones + owners), SLA-proposal-redwood.pdf (proposal with draft SLO table).

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das

Thanks Priyom — useful summary. Quick notes from Acme side: we can confirm the timeline in principle but will need procurement to run the PO through. Two quick asks from security:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood supports envelope encryption with our Azure Key Vault via BYOK?
2) Can you add a section in the SLA about data retention for debug logs (we will need a 90-day retention policy with deletion controls).

I'll loop in procurement separately (cc'd below). We expect to have a procurement update by Friday 2026-12-10 but will aim for earlier if possible.

cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>

—Jordan

Jordan — quick answers inline and a short update on owners' progress.

On 12/2/26 Jordan Price wrote:
> Can you confirm whether Redwood supports envelope encryption with our Azure Key Vault via BYOK?

Yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) with Azure Key Vault. I'll attach a short integration note and a configuration snippet. Action: Laura to send integration note (attachment: KMS-integration-note.pdf). Due: 2026-12-07.

> Add SLA section about data retention for debug logs (90-day retention)

Marissa will update the SLA PDF and include explicit retention and deletion controls. Action: Marissa (due 2026-12-09).

Progress updates: Marcus is finishing the benchmark spreadsheet; I reviewed a draft and the numbers look within target for P95. Marcus, please confirm final numbers by Monday EOD.

If procurement has questions about subscription vs committed pricing, we can prepare a short comparison table for the PO review.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan milestone summary + next-week MAP agenda

Folks — attaching the updated SLA (see SLA-proposal-redwood.pdf) and a short decision rollup below. Please reply with a single-line ack if you accept the SLA text so we can include it in the SOW.

Decision rollup (this checkpoint):
- Accept draft SLA with P95 <120ms, automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained, and 90-day debug log retention (ACCEPTED PENDING PO). Owner: Marissa.
- Benchmark report (Marcus) will include token-cost sensitivity table; if cost exceeds the threshold (per Acme internal target) we will propose a short optimization window before pilot start. Owner: Marcus, due 2026-12-06 (reported done; spreadsheet in Drive).
- KMS integration note (Laura) confirms BYOK via Azure Key Vault and includes sample config for the Private deployment. Owner: Laura (delivered).
- Procurement: Acme to deliver PO or redlines by 2026-12-10.

Next steps / next-week agenda (2026-12-14 checkpoint):
1) Confirm PO status and whether any commercial redlines remain.
2) Final accept/close of SLA and SOW language.
3) Pre-pilot runbook review (ops checklist + rollback plan).
4) If PO is in place: schedule pilot kickoff for 2026-12-20.

Attachments: SLA-proposal-redwood.pdf (final draft).

Please reply with ✅ if you accept the SLA language as-is (so I can bundle it for the SOW).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
